title: Broadcom extends Apple chip deal through 2031
title_zh: 博通将苹果芯片协议延长至 2031 年
summary: Broadcom Inc. (AVGO) just extended its chip supply agreement with Apple through 2031, according to a regulatory filing reported by Bloomberg. This partnership is not a new development.
summary_zh: 据彭博社报道的一份监管文件显示，博通公司 (AVGO) 刚刚将与苹果的芯片供应协议延长至 2031 年。这种伙伴关系并不是一个新的发展。

title: McCormick Is Shifting From the Spice Rack to the Refrigerator With This $45 Billion Deal
title_zh: 味好美公司通过这笔 450 亿美元的交易从调料架转向冰箱
summary: McCormick is combining with Unilever's food division to reduce its exposure to private label competition.
summary_zh: 味好美正在与联合利华的食品部门合并，以减少自有品牌竞争的风险。

title: Which Small Cap ETF Is the Better Buy in 2026? iShares and JPMorgan Have Compelling Offerings
title_zh: 2026 年哪种小盘 ETF 更值得购买？ iShares 和摩根大通提供引人注目的产品
summary: ISCB offers ultra-low costs and 1,500+ holdings for diversification, while BBSC concentrates on fewer names with higher recent returns.
summary_zh: ISCB 提供超低成本和 1,500 多种持股以实现多元化，而 BBSC 则专注于近期回报较高的少数公司。

title: Traders Are Dumping Tech Bonds to Make Room for Amazon Debt Deal
title_zh: 交易员正在抛售科技债券，为亚马逊债务交易腾出空间
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Amazon.com Inc.’s massive bond sale dragged down outstanding hyperscaler debt on Tuesday as investors sold existing securities to fund the new issue, signaling growing fatigue over the barrage of artificial intelligence financings.Most Read from BloombergGreece ...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——周二，亚马逊公司的大规模债券发行拖累了未偿超大规模债务，因为投资者出售了现有证券来为新发行的债券提供资金，这表明人们对人工智能融资的接二连三感到越来越疲劳。

title: Rivian Shares Drop After News Of 75 Million Share Public Offering
title_zh: Rivian 公开发行 7500 万股股票的消息传出后股价下跌
summary: Rivian stock dropped around 10% after it announced the public offering. The proceeds from the stock sale will go toward paying off a government loan.
summary_zh: Rivian 宣布公开募股后，其股价下跌约 10%。出售股票的收益将用于偿还政府贷款。
